proposals.text:
Thanks — I pulled what I can so far and a couple of important next-step notes before I proceed.

What I found (from your profile)
- Verified cards: Platinum Rewards, Gold Rewards, and EcoCard (EcoCard provides the largest credit-card APY bonus for Gold savings: +0.6%).
- You hold both Green and Purple checking accounts; per policy only the single highest checking-account APY boost is applied to your Gold savings (checking boosts do not stack). Some docs show Green often carries a larger boost than Purple (example: Green +0.75% vs Purple +0.1%), but the exact boost percent for your accounts is stored on your account record.

Limitation / required action
- To pull the exact savings balance used for the interest posting, confirm which APY components were applied last month, compute the expected interest, and (if needed) apply an interest correction, I must look up your specific bank accounts and the interest posting in the internal account systems.
- I do not have the internal bank-account lookup/apply-credit tools available in this chat to retrieve the statement-period balance or to post a correction directly.

Options — pick one
1) I can transfer you to a specialist (human agent) right now who can access your full account records, confirm exact balance and APY components, apply a correction immediately if required, and open the backend discrepancy report. If you want that, say “Please transfer” and I’ll proceed. (I’ll include a short summary of what we’ve done so far so the human can jump in quickly.)

2) I can continue here with an estimate: using the public KB values we do have (EcoCard +0.6% credit-card bonus; typical Green checking boost examples around +0.75%), I can show you how to estimate the expected monthly interest on a $96k balance under several APY scenarios so you can see what would be plausible vs. the $450 you received. This won’t access your actual posted balance or confirm what was applied.

Which would you like? If you want the transfer, I’ll confirm and then initiate it. If you want the estimate, I’ll show the calculations next.
